text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: infra-latency (P1) for hosted-inference-prod. primary on-call paged.

alex: seeing a bunch of pages for 503s and timeouts, across two regions. getting noisy.

mira: oof, I just woke up to three pages. checking metrics now. can someone confirm customer impact?

pagerduty-bot: Incident details:
```
Service: hosted-inference-prod
Trigger: error-rate > 5% over 1m
Escalation: primary -> secondary -> manager
Event id: evt_2026_5197070707
Pages fired: primary (alex) 1m, secondary (mira) 1m 05s, manager (oncall-manager) 2m 10s
```

sam: looks like primary didn't ack for ~70s because phone died. secondary got paged but PD retriggered a second escalation when a duplicate alert was ingested. possible dup fire.

jess: wait we have multiple identical PD incidents? I'm seeing two event ids separated by a few seconds. could be alert flood + dedupe gap.

alex: phone on. sorry I missed the first one, acked at 5197070780. I had DND on accidentally.

mira: I acked mine at 5197070810 but PD already escalated to manager before ack landed. manager pinged on-call bridge.

oncall-manager: got the page and join attempt from PD. joining bridge now. what's the current user impact?

alex: root cause looks like a config flapping on the autoscaler for the routing lambda causing elevated latencies and timeouts to the runtime. Regions us-east-1 and us-west-2 impacted intermittently.

sam: confirming spike in request latency and 502/504 errors at the edge. retry surge made it worse.

jess: customers saw failed inference calls and increased tail latency. some customers hit retries and started throttling. support ticket volume up ~15% in last 10m.

mira: recommend temporary silence on the PD policy to stop escalation storm while we mitigate, then manual follow-up. I can mute the policy if you want me to.

alex: please do: mute for 15m so we don't keep waking people. apply global silence on infra-latency.

pagerduty-bot: Manually silencing escalation policy 'infra-latency' for 15m as requested by mira.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Silence applied. Removing auto-escalations for this rule for 15 minutes.

sam: next step: roll back recent autoscaler config change from today (deploy 2026-03-15T01:02Z). I'm going to open a rollback PR and trigger a canary.

jess: can we also scale the pool to absorb the retry surge? temporary +2 nodes in dedicated pool?

alex: doing that now. scaling +2 GPUs in us-east-1. will post command output.

alex: Command:
```
redwoodctl scale pool inference-prod-us-east --add 2
```
Result: request accepted, provisioning started. expected up in ~90s.

mira: PR for rollback: https://git.company/repo/infra/changes/462. rolling back autoscaler flag `enable_aggressive_backoff`.

sam: good. once rollback is live we should see error-rate drop. keep silence until we verify stability.

oncall-manager: FYI PD already sent a manager escalation at 5197070837 because of duplicate incident enrollments. I acknowledged so we don't wake execs.

ajess: small note: because PD ingested duplicates we briefly had two active incidents, which triggered manager routing. we should file a PD dedupe bug.

mira: Agree. I'll create a follow-up task: link in thread when created.

pagerduty-bot: Event evt_2026_5197070707 resolved at 5197071200 (root cause mitigation in progress).

alex: error-rate back to baseline after rollback and scale. monitoring shows 1% error rate now.

sam: support ticket surge subsiding. keep an eye next 30m.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated, silence active until 5197071600. No active escalations.

mira: followups: 1) PD dedupe investigation 2) safer escalation window if primary unacked for <2m 3) runbook tweak to prefer manual mute before manager route. I'll draft changes.

oncall-manager: Thanks everyone. Good job moving quickly. Filing post-incident notes and impact summary.

jess: quick impact note for postmortem: ~3% of production requests failed for ~8 minutes with retries increasing cost for 10 customers. Need to quantify exact tokens lost.

mira: created follow-up task: https://tasks.company/INC-7201 "PD duplicate ingestion cause" assigned to sam.

alex: closing thread. will add timeline to postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
